sales_number_ck.name: sales_number_ck
sales_number_ck.value:
("pos"."sales"."status" not in ('completed', 'void') or ("pos"."sales"."number" is not null and "pos"."sales"."completed_at" is not null))
          and ("pos"."sales"."status" <> 'awaiting_payment' or "pos"."sales"."hold_number" is not null)

sales_hold_day_ck.name: sales_hold_day_ck
sales_hold_day_ck.value:
("pos"."sales"."hold_number" is null) = ("pos"."sales"."hold_day" is null)
          and ("pos"."sales"."cancel_reason" is null or "pos"."sales"."status" = 'cancelled')

sales_status_ck.name: sales_status_ck
sales_status_ck.value:
"pos"."sales"."status" in ('completed', 'void', 'awaiting_payment', 'cancelled')
          and ("pos"."sales"."status" = 'void') = ("pos"."sales"."voided_at" is not null)
          and ("pos"."sales"."status" = 'cancelled') = ("pos"."sales"."cancelled_at" is not null)

sales_money_ck.name: sales_money_ck
sales_money_ck.value:
"pos"."sales"."subtotal" >= 0 and "pos"."sales"."discount" >= 0 and "pos"."sales"."voucher_discount" >= 0
          and "pos"."sales"."discount" + "pos"."sales"."voucher_discount" <= "pos"."sales"."subtotal" and "pos"."sales"."tax" >= 0
          and "pos"."sales"."total" = "pos"."sales"."subtotal" - "pos"."sales"."discount" - "pos"."sales"."voucher_discount" + "pos"."sales"."tax"
          and "pos"."sales"."rounding" between 0 and 99
          and ("pos"."sales"."rounding" = 0 or ("pos"."sales"."total" + "pos"."sales"."rounding") % 100 = 0)
          and "pos"."sales"."change" = greatest("pos"."sales"."paid" - "pos"."sales"."total" - "pos"."sales"."rounding", 0) and "pos"."sales"."cost_total" >= 0
          and ("pos"."sales"."paid" >= "pos"."sales"."total" + "pos"."sales"."rounding" or "pos"."sales"."member_id" is not null)

receivable_payments_unrecorded_idx.name: receivable_payments_unrecorded_idx
receivable_payments_unrecorded_idx.where: "pos"."receivable_payments"."seq" is not null and "pos"."receivable_payments"."payment_id" is null

receivables_cancel_ck.name: receivables_cancel_ck
receivables_cancel_ck.value:
"pos"."receivables"."cancelled_amount" between 0 and "pos"."receivables"."total"
          and ("pos"."receivables"."cancelled_at" is not null or "pos"."receivables"."cancelled_amount" = 0)
          and ("pos"."receivables"."cancelled_at" is null or "pos"."receivables"."rest" = 0)

expenses_source_ck.name: expenses_source_ck
expenses_source_ck.value:
("pos"."expenses"."source" = 'drawer') = ("pos"."expenses"."shift_id" is not null)
          and ("pos"."expenses"."source" = 'drawer') = ("pos"."expenses"."drawer_cash_before" is not null)

expenses_void_ck.name: expenses_void_ck
expenses_void_ck.value:
("pos"."expenses"."voided_at" is null) = ("pos"."expenses"."voided_by_id" is null)
          and ("pos"."expenses"."voided_at" is null) = ("pos"."expenses"."voided_by_kind" is null)
          and ("pos"."expenses"."voided_at" is not null or "pos"."expenses"."void_reason" is null)
          and ("pos"."expenses"."drawer_reversed" is not null) = ("pos"."expenses"."voided_at" is not null and "pos"."expenses"."source" = 'drawer')

sale_voids_ck.name: sale_voids_ck
sale_voids_ck.value:
"pos"."sale_voids"."cash_returned" >= 0 and "pos"."sale_voids"."transfer_returned" >= 0 and "pos"."sale_voids"."receivable_cancelled" >= 0
          and "pos"."sale_voids"."cash_returned" + "pos"."sale_voids"."transfer_returned" + "pos"."sale_voids"."receivable_cancelled" = "pos"."sale_voids"."total" + "pos"."sale_voids"."rounding"
          and "pos"."sale_voids"."rounding" between 0 and 99
          and ("pos"."sale_voids"."cash_returned" = 0 or "pos"."sale_voids"."shift_id" is not null)
          and ("pos"."sale_voids"."reason_code" <> 'other' or "pos"."sale_voids"."note" is not null)
